tours.name: Create a Job Position and Open a Vacancy

name_i18n.en_US: Create a Job Position and Open a Vacancy

tours.description: Learn how to create a job position, link it to a department, set how many people you want to hire, and save it so applications can be received.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn how to create a job position, link it to a department, set how many people you want to hire, and save it so applications can be received.

steps.title: Open Employees
steps.description: Job positions are configured from the Employees app. The same positions are used by Recruitment, contracts and employee records.

description_i18n.en_US: Job positions are configured from the Employees app. The same positions are used by Recruitment, contracts and employee records.

steps.title: Configuration menu
steps.description: The Configuration menu holds the lists that define how HR works in your company, such as departments, job positions and working schedules.

description_i18n.en_US: The Configuration menu holds the lists that define how HR works in your company, such as departments, job positions and working schedules.

steps.title: Job Positions
steps.description: This list shows every position your company has defined, with its department and the number of people expected to be hired.

description_i18n.en_US: This list shows every position your company has defined, with its department and the number of people expected to be hired.

steps.title: New job position
steps.content: Click New to create a job position.

content_i18n.en_US: Click New to create a job position.

steps.description: The New button opens a blank job position form. Nothing is stored until you save it.

description_i18n.en_US: The New button opens a blank job position form. Nothing is stored until you save it.

steps.title: Job position name
steps.content: Type the name of the position, then press Tab.

content_i18n.en_US: Type the name of the position, then press Tab.

steps.description: The name is what applicants and employees will see, for example Sales Manager. Use the title you would put in a job advert.

description_i18n.en_US: The name is what applicants and employees will see, for example Sales Manager. Use the title you would put in a job advert.

steps.title: Search Department
steps.content: Click the field and type the first letters of what you are looking for.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the field and type the first letters of what you are looking for.

steps.description: The department tells Odoo which team the position belongs to. New employees hired into this position will start in that department. Typing narrows the list down; you pick the result in the next step.

description_i18n.en_US: The department tells Odoo which team the position belongs to. New employees hired into this position will start in that department. Typing narrows the list down; you pick the result in the next step.

steps.validation_message: Type at least two letters of what you are looking for.

validation_message_i18n.en_US: Type at least two letters of what you are looking for.

steps.title: Choose the department
steps.content: Click the result you want in the list.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the result you want in the list.

steps.description: Pick the team that will hire for the position. Start typing a name to narrow the list.

description_i18n.en_US: Pick the team that will hire for the position. Start typing a name to narrow the list.

steps.title: Recruitment tab
steps.description: This tab holds the settings that turn the position into a vacancy, such as how many people you want to hire.

description_i18n.en_US: This tab holds the settings that turn the position into a vacancy, such as how many people you want to hire.

steps.title: Number to recruit
steps.content: Type how many people you want to hire, then press Tab.

content_i18n.en_US: Type how many people you want to hire, then press Tab.

steps.description: The target is the number of vacancies for this position. It appears on the job card in the Recruitment app and helps you see how many hires are still missing.

description_i18n.en_US: The target is the number of vacancies for this position. It appears on the job card in the Recruitment app and helps you see how many hires are still missing.

steps.title: Save
steps.content: Click the save icon to keep the job position.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the save icon to keep the job position.

steps.description: Saving creates the position. It now appears in the Recruitment app, where applications can be received and followed.

description_i18n.en_US: Saving creates the position. It now appears in the Recruitment app, where applications can be received and followed.

steps.title: Position saved
steps.content: The job position is saved. Click its name to finish.

content_i18n.en_US: The job position is saved. Click its name to finish.

steps.description: The position name now appears at the top of the page. You can come back to this form at any time to change the target or the recruiter.

description_i18n.en_US: The position name now appears at the top of the page. You can come back to this form at any time to change the target or the recruiter.
